name: Export QNN .pte (Qualcomm NPU)
help: Also export model_qnn.pte, int8-quantized and lowered to the Qualcomm QNN backend for the Hexagon NPU (e.g. IQ-9075). A failure is logged and never fails training; see export_report.json.

name: QNN SoC model
help: ExecuTorch QcomChipset name to compile for. IQ-9075 EVK uses the QCS9100 (Hexagon v73) target.

name: QNN quantization
help: Activation/weight bit widths. 8a8w is the default and the fastest; 16a8w trades speed for accuracy.

name: QNN calibration samples
help: Training samples used to calibrate int8 ranges.
